```{r}
# ==========================================
# 0. REPRODUCIBILITY & DEVICE SETUP
# ==========================================
set_seed <- function(seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  torch_manual_seed(seed)
}

get_device <- function() {
  if (cuda_is_available()) {
    return(torch_device("cuda"))
  } else if (backends_mps_is_available()) {
    return(torch_device("mps")) # For Apple Silicon
  } else {
    return(torch_device("cpu"))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 1. DATA PREPROCESSING
# ==========================================
preprocess_and_build_dataset <- function(df) {
  # Force standard data.frame to prevent data.table subsetting errors
  df <- as.data.frame(df)

  # Label Encoding (Removed player_position)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      team_with_poss = case_when(
        team_with_poss == team_id ~ team_code,
        team_with_poss != team_id & team_code == "Attack" ~ "Defense",
        team_with_poss != team_id & team_code == "Defense" ~ "Attack",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      team_with_poss_idx = as.integer(as.factor(team_with_poss)),
      team_id_idx = as.integer(as.factor(team_id))
    ) %>% 
    group_by(player_id, event_id) %>%
    arrange(time_sec) %>%
    mutate(
      dist_to_ball = sqrt((x - x_ball)^2 + (y - y_ball)^2),
      vel_x = x - lag(x, default = first(x)),
      vel_y = y - lag(y, default = first(y))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  encoders <- list(
    num_teams = max(df$team_id_idx, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_poss_states = max(df$team_with_poss_idx, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  # Standard Scaling (Includes x_ball and y_ball)
  cont_cols <- c('x', 'y', 'ball_speed', 'x_ball', 'y_ball', 'dist_to_ball', 'vel_x', 'vel_y')

  # Now this base R subsetting will work perfectly
  scaler_center <- colMeans(df[, cont_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
  scaler_scale <- apply(df[, cont_cols], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

  df[, cont_cols] <- scale(df[, cont_cols], center = scaler_center, scale = scaler_scale)

  # Group by event_id and build graphs
  event_list <- df %>% group_split(event_id)
  graphs <- list()

  for (event_df in event_list) {
    event_id <- event_df$event_id[1]

    obs_df <- event_df %>% filter(time_sec <= 25)
    target_df <- event_df %>% filter(time_sec >= 26 & time_sec <= 30)

    obs_counts <- table(obs_df$player_id)
    target_counts <- table(target_df$player_id)

    # Find players with exactly 26 obs frames and 5 target frames
    valid_players <- names(obs_counts)[obs_counts == 25]
    valid_players <- valid_players[valid_players %in% names(target_counts)]
    valid_players <- valid_players[target_counts[valid_players] == 5]

    if (length(valid_players) < 2) next

    node_features_seq <- list()
    node_cat_features <- list()
    node_targets_seq <- list()

    for (pid in valid_players) {
      p_obs <- obs_df %>% filter(player_id == pid) %>% arrange(time_sec)
      p_tgt <- target_df %>% filter(player_id == pid) %>% arrange(time_sec)

      node_features_seq[[length(node_features_seq) + 1]] <- as.matrix(p_obs[, c('x', 'y', 'ball_speed', 'x_ball', 'y_ball', 'dist_to_ball', 'vel_x', 'vel_y')])

      # Removed player_position_idx here
      node_cat_features[[length(node_cat_features) + 1]] <- as.integer(p_obs[1, c('team_id_idx', 'team_with_poss_idx')])
      node_targets_seq[[length(node_targets_seq) + 1]] <- as.matrix(p_tgt[, c('x', 'y')])
    }

    # Convert to tensors
    x_cont <- torch_tensor(abind::abind(node_features_seq, along = 0), dtype = torch_float())
    x_cat <- torch_tensor(do.call(rbind, node_cat_features), dtype = torch_long())
    y_tgt <- torch_tensor(abind::abind(node_targets_seq, along = 0), dtype = torch_float())

    graphs[[length(graphs) + 1]] <- list(
      x_cont = x_cont, 
      x_cat = x_cat, 
      y = y_tgt, 
      num_nodes = length(valid_players),
      event_id = event_id
    )
  }

  list(graphs = graphs, encoders = encoders, scaler = list(center = scaler_center, scale = scaler_scale))
}

# Custom Dataset
TrajectoryDataset <- dataset(
  name = "TrajectoryDataset",
  initialize = function(graphs) { self$graphs <- graphs },
  .getitem = function(i) { self$graphs[[i]] },
  .length = function() { length(self$graphs) }
)
```

```{r}
TrajectorySeq2SeqGNN <- nn_module(
  "TrajectorySeq2SeqGNN",

  initialize = function(num_teams, num_poss_states, cont_dim = 8, hidden_dim = 64, dropout_rate = 0.2) {
    # 1. Categorical Embeddings
    self$team_emb <- nn_embedding(num_embeddings = num_teams + 1, embedding_dim = 4)
    self$poss_emb <- nn_embedding(num_embeddings = num_poss_states + 1, embedding_dim = 4)

    input_dim <- cont_dim + 4 + 4
    self$feat_proj <- nn_linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)

    # 2. SPATIAL LAYER (Graph Attention)
    self$spatial_attention <- nn_multihead_attention(embed_dim = hidden_dim, num_heads = 4, batch_first = TRUE)
    self$norm1 <- nn_layer_norm(hidden_dim)
    self$dropout1 <- nn_dropout(dropout_rate)

    # 3. TEMPORAL ENCODER
    self$temporal_encoder <- nn_lstm(input_size = hidden_dim, hidden_size = hidden_dim, 
                                     batch_first = TRUE, bidirectional = FALSE)

    # 4. AUTOREGRESSIVE DECODER COMPONENTS
    # Input to decoder step: [pos_x, pos_y, vel_x, vel_y, global_ctx (hidden_dim)]
    self$dec_input_proj <- nn_linear(2 + 2 + hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
    self$temporal_decoder <- nn_lstm(input_size = hidden_dim, hidden_size = hidden_dim, batch_first = TRUE)

    # 5. OUTPUT LAYER
    self$out <- nn_sequential(
      nn_linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
      nn_gelu(),
      nn_linear(hidden_dim, 2) # Predicts velocity (change in position)
    )
  },

  forward = function(batch) {
    x_cont <- batch$x_cont       
    team_idx <- batch$x_cat[, 1] 
    poss_idx <- batch$x_cat[, 2] 

    num_nodes <- x_cont$shape[1]
    seq_len <- x_cont$shape[2]

    # Extract last known kinematics (Assuming indices 7 and 8 are vel_x and vel_y)
    last_known_pos <- x_cont[, seq_len, 1:2] 
    last_known_vel <- x_cont[, seq_len, 7:8] 

    # Embeddings
    team_feat <- self$team_emb(team_idx)$unsqueeze(2)$expand(c(-1, seq_len, -1))
    poss_feat <- self$poss_emb(poss_idx)$unsqueeze(2)$expand(c(-1, seq_len, -1))

    x_in <- torch_cat(list(x_cont, team_feat, poss_feat), dim = 3)
    x_proj <- self$feat_proj(x_in) 

    # ==========================================
    # SPATIAL LAYER
    # ==========================================
    x_spatial_in <- x_proj$transpose(1, 2) 
    spatial_out <- self$spatial_attention(x_spatial_in, x_spatial_in, x_spatial_in)[[1]]

    x_spatio_temporal <- self$norm1(spatial_out$transpose(1, 2) + x_proj)
    x_spatio_temporal <- self$dropout1(x_spatio_temporal)

    # ==========================================
    # TEMPORAL ENCODER
    # ==========================================
    enc_out <- self$temporal_encoder(x_spatio_temporal)
    enc_states <- enc_out[[1]] 
    last_hidden <- enc_states[, seq_len, ] 

    # ==========================================
    # GLOBAL CONTEXT (Social Pooling)
    # ==========================================
    global_ctx <- last_hidden$max(dim = 1, keepdim = TRUE)[[1]] 
    global_ctx_exp <- global_ctx$expand(c(num_nodes, -1))

    # ==========================================
    # AUTOREGRESSIVE TEMPORAL DECODER
    # ==========================================
    # Initialize LSTM hidden states with the encoder's final state
    h_t <- last_hidden$unsqueeze(1) # Shape: [1, num_nodes, hidden_dim]
    c_t <- torch_zeros_like(h_t)
    hx <- list(h_t, c_t)

    current_pos <- last_known_pos
    current_vel <- last_known_vel

    preds <- list()

    # Loop step-by-step for the 5 future frames
    for (t in 1:5) {
      # 1. Combine current kinematics with global context
      step_in <- torch_cat(list(current_pos, current_vel, global_ctx_exp), dim = 2)
      step_in <- self$dec_input_proj(step_in)$unsqueeze(2) # Shape: [num_nodes, 1, hidden_dim]

      # 2. Pass through Decoder LSTM
      dec_out <- self$temporal_decoder(step_in, hx)
      dec_hidden <- dec_out[[1]] # Shape: [num_nodes, 1, hidden_dim]
      hx <- dec_out[[2]]         # Update hidden states for the next loop iteration

      # 3. Predict velocity (delta position)
      pred_vel <- self$out(dec_hidden$squeeze(2)) # Shape: [num_nodes, 2]

      # 4. Update kinematics for the next step
      current_pos <- current_pos + pred_vel
      current_vel <- pred_vel 

      # 5. Store the predicted position
      preds[[t]] <- current_pos$unsqueeze(2)
    }

    # Concatenate all 5 steps into final output tensor
    preds_tensor <- torch_cat(preds, dim = 2) # Shape: [num_nodes, 5, 2]

    return(preds_tensor)
  }
)
```


```{r}
# ==========================================
# 3. EARLY STOPPING & TRAINING
# ==========================================
compute_ade_loss_and_fde <- function(preds, targets, scaler) {
  mu <- c(scaler$center["x"], scaler$center["y"])
  sd <- c(scaler$scale["x"], scaler$scale["y"])
  device <- preds$device

  mu_tensor <- torch_tensor(mu, device = device)$view(c(1, 1, 2))
  sd_tensor <- torch_tensor(sd, device = device)$view(c(1, 1, 2))

  preds_real <- preds * sd_tensor + mu_tensor
  targets_real <- targets * sd_tensor + mu_tensor

  diff_sq <- (preds_real - targets_real)$pow(2)
  distances <- torch_sqrt(diff_sq$sum(dim = 3) + 1e-8)

  ade_loss <- distances$mean()
  seq_len <- distances$shape[2]

  # Extract FDE as a tensor for backprop and as an item for evaluation
  fde_loss <- distances[, seq_len]$mean()
  fde <- fde_loss$item()

  return(list(ade_loss = ade_loss, fde_loss = fde_loss, fde = fde))
}

EarlyStopping <- R6Class("EarlyStopping",
  public = list(
    patience = NULL, delta = NULL, counter = 0, best_loss = NULL,
    early_stop = FALSE, best_model_wts = NULL,
    initialize = function(patience = 10, delta = 0.0001) {
      self$patience <- patience
      self$delta <- delta
    },
    step = function(val_loss, model) {
      if (is.null(self$best_loss)) {
        self$best_loss <- val_loss
        self$best_model_wts <- lapply(model$parameters, function(x) x$clone())
      } else if (val_loss > self$best_loss - self$delta) {
        self$counter <- self$counter + 1
        if (self$counter >= self$patience) self$early_stop <- TRUE
      } else {
        self$best_loss <- val_loss
        self$best_model_wts <- lapply(model$parameters, function(x) x$clone())
        self$counter <- 0
      }
    }
  )
)

run_training <- function(df_raw, max_epochs = 100, patience = 10) {
  set_seed(42)
  device <- get_device()

  prep_data <- preprocess_and_build_dataset(df_raw)
  graphs <- prep_data$graphs
  encoders <- prep_data$encoders
  scaler <- prep_data$scaler

  num_graphs <- length(graphs)
  indices <- sample(seq_len(num_graphs))

  train_idx <- indices[1:floor(0.7 * num_graphs)]
  val_idx <- indices[(floor(0.7 * num_graphs) + 1):floor(0.85 * num_graphs)]
  test_idx <- indices[(floor(0.85 * num_graphs) + 1):num_graphs]

  train_dataset <- TrajectoryDataset(graphs[train_idx])
  val_dataset <- TrajectoryDataset(graphs[val_idx])
  test_dataset <- TrajectoryDataset(graphs[test_idx])

  train_loader <- dataloader(train_dataset, batch_size = 1, shuffle = TRUE)
  val_loader <- dataloader(val_dataset, batch_size = 1, shuffle = FALSE)
  test_loader <- dataloader(test_dataset, batch_size = 1, shuffle = FALSE)

  model <- TrajectorySeq2SeqGNN(
    num_teams = encoders$num_teams,
    num_poss_states = encoders$num_poss_states,
    cont_dim = 8
  )$to(device = device)

  optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.001, weight_decay = 1e-5)
  scheduler <- lr_reduce_on_plateau(optimizer, mode = "min", factor = 0.5, patience = 2)
  early_stopping <- EarlyStopping$new(patience = patience)

  for (epoch in 1:max_epochs) {
    model$train()
    train_fde <- 0
    total_nodes_train <- 0

    coro::loop(for (batch in train_loader) {
      batch$x_cont <- batch$x_cont[1, , , ]$to(device = device)
      batch$x_cat <- batch$x_cat[1, , ]$to(device = device)
      batch$y <- batch$y[1, , , ]$to(device = device)

      optimizer$zero_grad()
      predictions <- model(batch)
      metrics <- compute_ade_loss_and_fde(predictions, batch$y, scaler)

      # Combine ADE and FDE for loss to ensure intermediate steps are learned, but FDE is prioritized
      loss <- metrics$ade_loss + metrics$fde_loss
      loss$backward()
      nn_utils_clip_grad_norm_(model$parameters, max_norm = 1.0)
      optimizer$step()

      num_nodes <- batch$num_nodes$item()
      train_fde <- train_fde + metrics$fde * num_nodes
      total_nodes_train <- total_nodes_train + num_nodes
    })

    train_fde <- train_fde / total_nodes_train

    model$eval()
    val_fde <- 0
    total_nodes_val <- 0

    with_no_grad({
      coro::loop(for (batch in val_loader) {
        batch$x_cont <- batch$x_cont[1, , , ]$to(device = device)
        batch$x_cat <- batch$x_cat[1, , ]$to(device = device)
        batch$y <- batch$y[1, , , ]$to(device = device)

        predictions <- model(batch)
        metrics <- compute_ade_loss_and_fde(predictions, batch$y, scaler)

        num_nodes <- batch$num_nodes$item()
        val_fde <- val_fde + metrics$fde * num_nodes
        total_nodes_val <- total_nodes_val + num_nodes
      })
    })

    val_fde <- val_fde / total_nodes_val

    # Scheduler and Early Stopping now monitor FDE
    scheduler$step(val_fde)

    cat(sprintf("Epoch %03d | Train FDE: %.2f | Val FDE: %.2f\n", epoch, train_fde, val_fde))

    early_stopping$step(val_fde, model)
    if (early_stopping$early_stop) break
  }

  with_no_grad({
    for (i in seq_along(model$parameters)) {
      model$parameters[[i]]$copy_(early_stopping$best_model_wts[[i]])
    }
  })

  return(list(model = model, test_dataset = test_dataset, val_loader = val_loader, scaler = scaler))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. CONFORMAL PREDICTION (REGRESSION-SPLIT)
# ==========================================

calibrate_conformal <- function(model, val_loader, scaler, alpha = 0.1) {
  model$eval()
  device <- model$parameters[[1]]$device

  # Prepare unscaling tensors
  mu <- c(scaler$center["x"], scaler$center["y"])
  sd <- c(scaler$scale["x"], scaler$scale["y"])
  mu_tensor <- torch_tensor(mu, device = device)$view(c(1, 1, 2))
  sd_tensor <- torch_tensor(sd, device = device)$view(c(1, 1, 2))

  # We will store scores for each of the 5 future time steps separately
  seq_len <- 5 
  scores_per_step <- vector("list", seq_len)

  with_no_grad({
    coro::loop(for (batch in val_loader) {
      # Format batch exactly as in the training loop
      batch$x_cont <- batch$x_cont[1, , , ]$to(device = device)
      batch$x_cat <- batch$x_cat[1, , ]$to(device = device)
      batch$y <- batch$y[1, , , ]$to(device = device)

      # Get predictions
      preds <- model(batch)

      # Unscale predictions and targets to real pitch coordinates
      preds_real <- preds * sd_tensor + mu_tensor
      y_true_real <- batch$y * sd_tensor + mu_tensor

      # Calculate Euclidean distance (Non-conformity score)
      diff_sq <- (preds_real - y_true_real)$pow(2)
      distances <- torch_sqrt(diff_sq$sum(dim = 3) + 1e-8) # Shape: [num_nodes, seq_len]

      # Convert to R matrix and store by time step
      dist_matrix <- as.matrix(distances$cpu())
      for(t in 1:seq_len) {
        scores_per_step[[t]] <- c(scores_per_step[[t]], dist_matrix[, t])
      }
    })
  })

  # Calculate q_hat for each time step using the split-conformal formula
  # q = ceiling((n + 1) * (1 - alpha)) / n
  q_hats <- numeric(seq_len)
  for(t in 1:seq_len) {
    n <- length(scores_per_step[[t]])
    q_level <- ceiling((n + 1) * (1 - alpha)) / n
    q_level <- min(q_level, 1.0) # Cap at 1.0 for safety

    q_hats[t] <- quantile(scores_per_step[[t]], probs = q_level, names = FALSE)
  }

  cat(sprintf("Conformal Radii (alpha=%.2f) for steps 1 to 5:\n", alpha))
  print(round(q_hats, 2))

  return(list(scores = scores_per_step, q_hats = q_hats, alpha = alpha))
}

predict_with_regions <- function(model, test_dataset, scaler, q_hats) {
  model$eval()
  device <- model$parameters[[1]]$device

  mu <- c(scaler$center["x"], scaler$center["y"])
  sd <- c(scaler$scale["x"], scaler$scale["y"])
  mu_tensor <- torch_tensor(mu, device = device)$view(c(1, 1, 2))
  sd_tensor <- torch_tensor(sd, device = device)$view(c(1, 1, 2))

  test_loader <- dataloader(test_dataset, batch_size = 1, shuffle = FALSE)
  results_df <- list()

  with_no_grad({
    coro::loop(for (batch in test_loader) {
      event_id <- batch$event_id$item()

      batch$x_cont <- batch$x_cont[1, , , ]$to(device = device)
      batch$x_cat <- batch$x_cat[1, , ]$to(device = device)
      batch$y <- batch$y[1, , , ]$to(device = device)

      preds <- model(batch)

      preds_real <- preds * sd_tensor + mu_tensor
      y_true_real <- batch$y * sd_tensor + mu_tensor

      preds_array <- as.array(preds_real$cpu())
      y_true_array <- as.array(y_true_real$cpu())

      num_nodes <- dim(preds_array)[1]
      seq_len <- dim(preds_array)[2]

      # Flatten into a dataframe for easy plotting
      for (node in 1:num_nodes) {
        for (t in 1:seq_len) {
          results_df[[length(results_df) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            event_id = event_id,
            node_id = node,
            time_step = t,
            pred_x = preds_array[node, t, 1],
            pred_y = preds_array[node, t, 2],
            true_x = y_true_array[node, t, 1],
            true_y = y_true_array[node, t, 2],
            conf_radius = q_hats[t] # Assign the specific radius for this time step
          )
        }
      }
    })
  })

  return(bind_rows(results_df))
}
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 5. PLOTTING CONFORMAL PREDICTION REGIONS
# ==========================================
plot_conformal_event <- function(target_event_id, events_prepared, test_predictions) {
  
  # 1. Extract Historical Trajectories (Observation window: time_sec <= 25)
  hist_data <- events_prepared %>%
    filter(event_id == target_event_id, time_sec <= 25) %>%
    # Calculate group logic to connect paths properly
    arrange(player_id, time_sec)
  
  # 2. Extract Predictions & Conformal Radii for the specific event
  pred_data <- test_predictions %>%
    filter(event_id == target_event_id)
  
  # 3. Build the Plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Draw the pitch (Defaults to 105 x 68 which matches your variables)
    annotate_pitch(
      dimensions = pitch_international,
      fill       = NA,
      colour     = "white", # White lines pop better against 'magma' colors
      limits     = FALSE
    ) + 
    theme_pitch() +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#222a35")) +
    
    # --- A. CONFORMAL REGIONS (Heatmap Tube) ---
    # Using geom_circle with alpha to create a glowing heatmap effect.
    # The radius maps perfectly to your unscaled q_hats.
    geom_circle(data = pred_data,
                aes(x0 = pred_x, y0 = pred_y, r = conf_radius, 
                    fill = as.factor(time_step), group = node_id),
                color = NA, alpha = 0.2) +
    # Use a warm color palette to simulate the heatmap intensity
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Predicted seconds") +
    
    # --- B. HISTORICAL TRAJECTORY (Train) ---
    geom_path(data = hist_data %>% group_by(player_id) %>% slice_tail(n = 5), 
              aes(x = x, y = y, group = player_id),
              color = "white", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
    # Emphasize the last known historical position
    geom_point(data = hist_data %>% group_by(player_id) %>% slice_tail(n = 1), 
               aes(x = x, y = y),
               color = "white", size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "black") +

    # --- C. PREDICTED TRAJECTORY ---
    geom_path(data = pred_data, 
              aes(x = pred_x, y = pred_y, group = node_id),
              color = "#00f5d4", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(data = pred_data, 
               aes(x = pred_x, y = pred_y, group = node_id),
               color = "#00f5d4", size = 2) +

    # --- D. TRUE TRAJECTORY (Test) ---
    geom_path(data = pred_data, 
              aes(x = true_x, y = true_y, group = node_id),
              color = "#ffb703", linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    geom_point(data = pred_data, 
               aes(x = true_x, y = true_y, group = node_id),
               color = "#ffb703", size = 2) +

    # Labels and aesthetics
    labs(x = "", y = "") +
    coord_fixed(
      xlim = c(0, 105), 
      ylim = c(0, 68), 
      expand = FALSE 
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = 5, xend = 25, y = 4, yend = 4,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "playfair", base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1A1A1A", colour = NA), 
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#DDDDDD", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.title       = element_blank(), 
      axis.text        = element_blank(), 
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      plot.margin      = margin(24, 28, 18, 28),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = "#DDDDDD", linewidth = 0.4),
  
      # Top facet labels (Quantiles / Mean)
      strip.text.x = element_text(
        colour = "#111111", 
        size = 12, 
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 8, b = 8)
      ),
  
      # Side facet labels (Attack / Defense)
      strip.text.y = element_text(
        colour = "#111111", 
        size = 16,           # Increased size for the side text
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(l = 8, r = 8) # Use left/right margin for vertical text padding
      )
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
  filter(player_id == 'ball') %>% 
  select(period, time_sec_orig = time_seg, x_ball = x_pitch, y_ball = y_pitch, match_id)

pitch_length <- 105
pitch_width <- 68
```

```{r}
results <- run_training(events_prepared, max_epochs = 105, patience = 5)

model <- results$model
test_dataset <- results$test_dataset
val_loader <- results$val_loader # NEW: Extract validation loader
scaler <- results$scaler
```

```{r}
# 1. Calibrate to get the 90% prediction regions (alpha = 0.1)
# This uses the validation loader as the calibration set (D2)
conformal_calib <- calibrate_conformal(
  model = model, 
  val_loader = val_loader, 
  scaler = scaler, 
  alpha = 0.10 
)

# 2. Apply to the Test Set
test_predictions <- predict_with_regions(
  model = model, 
  test_dataset = test_dataset, 
  scaler = scaler, 
  q_hats = conformal_calib$q_hats
)

head(test_predictions)
```

```{r}
ids <- events_prepared %>% 
  arrange(player_id, time_sec) %>% 
  distinct(event_id, team_name, team_code, player_id) %>% 
  group_by(event_id) %>% 
  mutate(node_id = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_distances <- test_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    distance = sqrt((pred_x - true_x)^2 + (pred_y - true_y)^2)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(ids)

ade_per_event <- df_distances %>%
  group_by(team_code) %>%
  summarize(ADE = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

fde_per_event <- df_distances %>%
  group_by(team_code, node_id) %>%
  filter(time_step == max(time_step)) %>%
  group_by(team_code) %>%
  summarize(FDE = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

results_table <- ade_per_event %>%
  left_join(fde_per_event, by = "team_code") %>%
  mutate(
    ADE = round(ADE, 2),
    FDE = round(FDE, 2)
  )

results_table
```

```{r}
df_distances <- test_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    distance = sqrt((pred_x - true_x)^2 + (pred_y - true_y)^2)
  )

# 2. Calculate ADE per event_id
ade_per_event <- df_distances %>%
  group_by(event_id) %>%
  summarize(ADE = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Calculate FDE per event_id
fde_per_event <- df_distances %>%
  # First, isolate the final time step for each node within each event
  group_by(event_id, node_id) %>%
  filter(time_step == max(time_step)) %>%
  # Second, calculate the mean of those final distances per event
  group_by(event_id) %>%
  summarize(FDE = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4. Combine into a final table
results_table2 <- ade_per_event %>%
  left_join(fde_per_event, by = "event_id") %>%
  mutate(
    ADE = round(ADE, 2),
    FDE = round(FDE, 2)
  )

results_table2
```
